{{Quote|We have rebel scum bolting from their hole! Stop them, Mu 1!|An Imperial officer, ordering Mu 1 to battle the Rebels leaving ''Pi''|<ref name="TIE">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
'''''Pi''''' was a [[Class-D cargo container]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. At one point, it was identified as a Rebel arms cache by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|starfleet]] and attacked by the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] [[Scythis (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Scythis'']] and the [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|Assault Gunboat]] [[Mu 1]]. ''Pi'' was defended by a small field of [[Mine Type A|Type 1 mines]] that were each armed with a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]]. After the [[Gunboat/Legends|gunboat]] destroyed the [[Space mine/Legends|mines]] and began inspecting ''Pi'', the container released the Rebel [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport]] ''[[Weet]]''. However, Mu 1 disabled the [[Transport/Legends|transport]], allowing ''Scythis'' to capture the Rebels aboard. The gunboat then destroyed ''Pi''.<ref name="TIE" />

The battle was subsequently replicated in an Imperial gunboat [[TIE pilot|pilot]] [[Flight simulator/Legends|flight simulator]]. Soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] was among the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] trainees.<ref name="TIE" />
